evals.prompt: Devo preparare la sessione di sabato per la mia campagna di Symbaroum. I PG (una strega, un cacciatore di taglie e uno studioso di Ordo Magica) hanno appena scoperto che un villaggio ai margini del Davokar è stato abbandonato in una notte. Scrivi l'avventura completa per una sessione di 4 ore.
evals.expected_output: Complete Italian adventure document: dramatic question, strong start, ~10 secrets/clues, 4-6 scenes with visual:/mood: fields in English, NPCs with want/fear/mannerism, flexible climax, hook-ignored fallback

evals.prompt: I need images for my Call of Cthulhu one-shot set in a 1920s Ligurian fishing village. Scenes: 1) the village seen from an arriving boat at dusk, fog rolling in; 2) the abandoned lighthouse interior, keeper's dinner still on the table covered in mold; 3) portrait of Don Ruggero, the village priest hiding a terrible secret, gaunt, always clutching his rosary. Give me Midjourney prompts.
evals.expected_output: Three ready-to-paste English MJ prompts with consistent 1920s horror style block, correct params (--ar, --exp), shot types stated, no junk tokens like '8k masterpiece'

evals.prompt: Mi servono le musiche per la sessione di stasera di Vileborn: 1) tema di esplorazione per le catacombe sotto la cattedrale, 2) traccia di combattimento per lo scontro con l'Angelo Caduto (boss finale), 3) qualcosa di malinconico per il funerale del PNG amico dei PG. Dammi i prompt per Suno.
evals.expected_output: Three Suno cues: English style prompts (4-7 descriptors, gothic grimdark palette), lyrics-field blocks with meta tags ending in [End], instrumental settings + slider advice, table usage notes

evals.prompt: Devo preparare la sessione di sabato per la mia campagna di Symbaroum. evals.expected_output: Italian table-ready document following references/modello.md: at-a-glance table, dramatic question, 3-5 revelations each with at least three clues across at least two scenes, clock of 4-6 steps ending in 'Se nessuno interviene', world truths, strong start as a > read-aloud block with senses only, scene map, 4-6 scenes each with 'Da non perdere qui', 'Cosa succede da sé', 'Chi c'è' with a line per NPC, 'Indizi qui', 'Se i PG… | Allora…' table and 'Se deragliano', clue tracker table, NPC table with name bank, visual:/mood: only in the closing appendix. No sentence where a PC is the subject of an action, decision or emotion. No em or en dashes. Symbaroum stats marked [da manuale] rather than invented. Every scene, including the climax, opens with a short > read-aloud block; 'Indizi qui' writes each clue in full ('- **I4.** text (R1)'), not just its ID; every bold field is its own paragraph with a blank line before it. python3 plugins/rpg-prep/skills/enhanced-avventure-rpg/scripts/controlla.py <output> exits 0.

evals.prompt: Sistema questa avventura per il tavolo: durante la sessione non trovo niente. Non cambiare i contenuti.
evals.expected_output: Same content as the input restructured into the template, comparable to references/esempio.md: the ten secrets regrouped into 3-5 revelations with clue IDs; 'Se i giocatori ignorano l'esca' moved into the clock's last step; Occasioni di Dissonanza moved into each scene's 'Da non perdere qui'; PG secrets surfaced in the scenes they touch; stat blocks and pregenerati under 'Schede'; 'Tempi indicativi' in the header; Scene 5 written as a full scene instead of 'Vedi Climax flessibile'; every visual:/mood: moved to the appendix.
